title: The Entry Window — RCB vs SRH
match: Royal Challengers Bangalore vs Sunrisers Hyderabad
hook_variants: SRH were at 115/2. The score looked fine. The probability said something else.
Score went up. Wickets stayed 2. But the probability was quietly falling.
This is what the score can't show you.
voiceover: SRH chasing 150 at Chepauk. Over 14. Score: 102 for 2. Runs coming. No wickets. Everyone thinks: chase is on. But the model read the required rate quietly climbing above 10. Dot-ball pressure. Venue doesn't ease late chases. Probability was already at 79 percent and falling — not rising. Over 15: 67 percent. Over 16: 55 percent. Score still climbing. Wickets still 2. Probability declining. Then over 17: three wickets. One run. Match over. The model saw it. The score didn't show it.
